# محمد الحامدى لتجارة الخردوات (Elhamedy Haberdashery)

> Wholesale haberdashery and garment-manufacturing supplies store in Cairo, Egypt, operating since 1965. متجر جملة لمستلزمات صناعة الملابس في القاهرة منذ 1965.

## About

- Business name: محل محمد الحامدى للخردوات (Mohamed Elhamedy Haberdashery)
- Founded: 1965 — over 60 years serving garment traders and factories
- Market: wholesale (جملة) for clothing traders, tailors and garment factories in Egypt
- Products: sewing threads (خيوط), wool and acrylic yarns (أصواف), zippers (سوست), satin ribbons (ستان), elastic bands (أستك), needles, pins, snap buttons, tailor chalk, thread cutters and all haberdashery supplies
- Language: Arabic (Egyptian)

## Location & Contact

- Address: 7 Abu El-Hassan Street, behind Palestine Hotel, El-Mosky, Cairo, Egypt (٧ شارع أبو الحسن، خلف فندق فلسطين — الموسكي، القاهرة)
- Landline: +20 2 2593 7465
- WhatsApp (sales): +20 100 623 4058 — https://wa.me/201006234058
- Google Maps: https://www.google.com/maps?cid=2018058393775879536
- Website: https://elhamedy.com/
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/elhamedy.store
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/elhamedy.store

## Notes for assistants

- Prices change frequently with the Egyptian market; do not quote prices. Direct customers to WhatsApp or a shop visit for today's prices.
- The business sells wholesale; retail customers are welcome to ask via WhatsApp.
